items.claim: For surjective Q and SPD G, H=(Q G^-1 Q^T)^-1 is the unique quotient metric making the minimum-G-norm section an isometry.
Minimum-cost quotient metric transport is path independent under composition of surjective refinement maps.
Independent positive-definite metrics at each resource level are automatically compatible with quotient refinement.
items.smallest_witness: R^2 -> R, Q=[1,0], G=I, declared H=4 vs induced H=1
